background: Deutsche Bank is Germany's largest bank, a universal bank with a large investment bank, a corporate bank, German retail banking under the Deutsche and Postbank brands, and the DWS asset manager.
synthesis: Fitch rates the bank A+ after its upgrade on 12 May 2026 and S&P A, both on positive outlook, with Moody's at A1 stable. The ratios are on the weak side of EU and Nordic banks: CET1 of 13.9%, leverage of 4.5% and LCR of 140% are all in the bottom quarter, and NSFR of 118% is below the peer median. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods to 30 Jun 2026. The newest flagged item, on 8 Sep 2026, is a legal settlement, as are most of the others, none of them a credit event; the two positive outlooks are the direction that counts.
